corrections.text: The 'What We Don't Know' section states that exact CVSS scores for several lower-severity fixes were not published in the sources reviewed. This is incorrect: the article's own cited primary source, GitLab's official release notes at docs.gitlab.com, publishes a full CVSS vector and score for every one of the 13 fixes, including the lowest-severity one (CVE-2025-14562, CVSS 3.1).
